title: Four-star general from the Clinton administration got inside the program

tellings.quote: I also know a four-star general from the Clinton administration who was able to go there, use his authority, his power uh to go see the program and get inside,

plain: In the 1990s a four-star general from the Clinton administration used his authority to get into a hidden program said to hold recovered crashed craft not made by humans, and saw it for himself. The physicist Eric W. Davis, who has worked as a Pentagon contractor, tells this on the show, saying he knows the general, who was "able to go there, use his authority, his power" to "see the program and get inside." If true, it would mean such a program exists and that even top officers have to push hard to get in.
